# Bodemindicatorenset Landbouwgronden Nederland (BLN)

Bodemindicatoren voor Landbouwgronden in Nederland. A soil quality
assessment framework for application in the Netherlands.

This R package can be used to calculate the BLN index for agricultural
fields in the Netherlands. the BLN framework has been developed to
evaluate the quality of soils in view of four ecosystem services the
soil supplies, including crop production, carbon sequestration, nutrient
efficiency and water quantity and quality. More information about this
framework can be found in the publication of [Ros et al.,
2023](https://edepot.wur.nl/634579)

## Installation

``` r

# Install the development version from GitHub
remotes::install_github("https://github.com/nmi-agro/BLN")

# Load the BLN package in your script
library("BLN")
```

## More information

The BLN has been developed by various soil experts, researchers and farm
advisors, guided by researchers from Wageningen UR and the Nutrient
Management Institute. The technical implementation in this R package is
done by NMI.

![Logo of
NMI](https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/C560BAQEYGcm4HjNnxA/company-logo_200_200/0?e=2159024400&v=beta&t=u40rJ7bixPWB2SAqaj3KCKzJRoKcqf0wUXCdmsTDQvw)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bln_add_management()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_add_management.md)
  : Estimate default values for management
- [`bln_b_diseaseresistance()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_b_diseaseresistance.md)
  : Calculate indicator for soil resistance for soil based diseases
- [`bln_b_pmn()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_b_pmn.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the index for the microbial biological
  activity in the Netherlands
- [`bln_bbwp_bw()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_bbwp_bw.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the water buffering capacity of
  soils in view of water retention in soil
- [`bln_bbwp_ngw()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_bbwp_ngw.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the N buffering capacity of soils
  in view of water purification for groundwater quality
- [`bln_bbwp_nsw()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_bbwp_nsw.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the N buffering capacity of soils
  in view of water purification for surface quality
- [`bln_bbwp_psw()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_bbwp_psw.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the P buffering capacity of soils
  in view of water purification for surface quality
- [`bln_c_cec()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_c_cec.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the soil fertility based on the CEC
- [`bln_c_magnesium()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_c_magnesium.md)
  : Calculate the capacity of soils to supply Magnesium for the BLN
  production function
- [`bln_c_nitrogen()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_c_nitrogen.md)
  : Calculate the soil nitrogen supplying capacity in the Netherlands
- [`bln_c_ph()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_c_ph.md) :
  Calculate the distance for target for soil pH in view of the BLN
  production function
- [`bln_c_posphor()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_c_posphor.md)
  : Calculate the phosphate availability index in the Netherlands
- [`bln_c_potassium()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_c_potassium.md)
  : Calculate the K availability index for the Netherlands
- [`bln_c_sulfur()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_c_sulfur.md)
  : Calculate the capacity of soils to supply sulfur for the BLN
  production function
- [`bln_calc_psp()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_calc_psp.md)
  : Calculate the precipitation surplus
- [`bln_clim_cbalance()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_clim_cbalance.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate a default SOM balance
- [`bln_clim_csat()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_clim_csat.md)
  : Function to evaluate the carbon saturation via max C saturation
  potential estimated via ML modelling
- [`bln_clim_rothc()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_clim_rothc.md)
  : Function to evaluate the carbon saturation via RothC simulation
- [`bln_clim_somers()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_clim_somers.md)
  : Function to evaluate the carbon saturation via SOMERS simulation on
  peat soils
- [`bln_crops`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_crops.md) :
  Linking table between crops and different functions in OBIC
- [`bln_evaluate_logistic()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_evaluate_logistic.md)
  : Evaluate a soil quality function using the general logistic function
- [`bln_evaluate_logistic_gaus_down()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_evaluate_logistic_gaus_down.md)
  : Evaluate logistically initially and gausian eventually
- [`bln_evaluate_parabolic()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_evaluate_parabolic.md)
  : Evaluate a soil quality function using a parabolic function
- [`bln_farm_hf`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_farm_hf.md)
  : An example dataset with all BLN input prepared for de Marke farm
- [`bln_field()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_field.md)
  : Calculate the BLN score for one field
- [`bln_field_dt()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_field_dt.md)
  : Calculate the BLN score for one field using a data.table as input
- [`bln_field_optimiser()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_field_optimiser.md)
  : Optimize the crop rotation plan for soil quality improvement
- [`bln_format_aer()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_format_aer.md)
  : Convert possible B_AER_CBS values to standardized values
- [`bln_format_gtclass()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_format_gtclass.md)
  : Determine groundwater table class based on highest and lowest mean
  groundwater levels
- [`bln_input_description`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_input_description.md)
  : A dataset with all input variables required by the BLN package
- [`bln_lsw`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_lsw.md) :
  Local Surface Water properties needed for BBWP functions
- [`bln_lsw_farm_hf`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_lsw_farm_hf.md)
  : An example dataset with all LSW properties related to the fields of
  the Marke farm
- [`bln_makkink`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_makkink.md)
  : Makkink correction factor table
- [`bln_nut_nitrogen()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_nut_nitrogen.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the nitrogen use efficiency in
  view of the soils' function to improve nutrient recycling
- [`bln_nut_nue()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_nut_nue.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the NUE
- [`bln_nut_phosphorus()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_nut_phosphorus.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the phosphorus use efficiency in
  view of the soils' function to improve nutrient recycling
- [`bln_nut_potassium()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_nut_potassium.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the potassium use efficiency in
  view of the soils' function to improve nutrient recycling
- [`bln_output_description`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_output_description.md)
  : A dataset with all output variables generated by the BLN package
- [`bln_p_aggstability()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_aggstability.md)
  : Calculate and evaluates the aggregate stability index based on
  occupation CEC
- [`bln_p_compaction()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_compaction.md)
  : Calculate and evaluates the risk for subsoil compaction
- [`bln_p_crumbleability()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_crumbleability.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the crumbleability in view of the soils
  production function
- [`bln_p_density()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_density.md)
  : Calculate the bulk density
- [`bln_p_droughtstress()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_droughtstress.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the yield depression due to drought in view
  of the capacity of soils to produce food
- [`bln_p_sealing()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_sealing.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the soil sealing risk
- [`bln_p_waterstress()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_waterstress.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the yield depression due to drought or
  wetness in view of the capacity of soils to produce food
- [`bln_p_wetnessstress()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_wetnessstress.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the yield depression due to wet conditions in
  view of the capacity of soils to produce food
- [`bln_p_whc()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_whc.md)
  : Calculate indicators for water holding capacity in the topsoil
- [`bln_p_windererosion()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_windererosion.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the indicator for wind erodibility in view of
  food production
- [`bln_p_workability()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_p_workability.md)
  : Calculate and evaluate the soil health for workability
- [`bln_parms`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_parms.md) :
  Table with BLN parameters being used in the package
- [`bln_rothc()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc.md)
  : RothC calculation motor
- [`bln_rothc_event()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_event.md)
  : Combine all EVENT data needed for RothC modelling for the
  Netherlands
- [`bln_rothc_event_amendment()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_event_amendment.md)
  : Calculate the monthly timing of carbon inputs for different
  fertilizer strategies for the Netherlands
- [`bln_rothc_event_crop()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_event_crop.md)
  : Calculate the crop rotation related C inputs of a field on monthly
  basis for the Netherlands
- [`bln_rothc_field()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_field.md)
  : Function for simple RothC simulation for grassland and cropland
  field
- [`bln_rothc_input_amendment()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_input_amendment.md)
  : Do check and expand amendment input table for RothC for the
  Netherlands
- [`bln_rothc_input_crop()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_input_crop.md)
  : Do check and expand crop input table for RothC for the Netherlands
- [`bln_rothc_input_rmf()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_input_rmf.md)
  : Estimate the rate modifying factors for the RothC modelling
- [`bln_rothc_multicore()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_multicore.md)
  : Function to evaluate the carbon saturation via RothC simulation on
  multiple fields using multicore processing
- [`bln_rothc_sim()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_rothc_sim.md)
  : Simulate SOC evolution using Roth-C for the Netherlands
- [`bln_scen_croprotation`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_scen_croprotation.md)
  : A dataset with potential crop rotation scenarios per agricultural
  economic region
- [`bln_soiltype`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_soiltype.md)
  : Table with country specific soil types being used to evaluate soil
  quality
- [`bln_somers`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_somers.md)
  : A dataset with meta-model results from SOMERS per unique base
  combination peat soil
- [`bln_thresholds`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_thresholds.md)
  : Table with country specific threshold values to evaluate
  soilquality'
- [`bln_wat_groundwater_recharge()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_wat_groundwater_recharge.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the groundwater recharge in view
  of the soils' function to retain water
- [`bln_wat_nretention_gw()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_wat_nretention_gw.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the N retention in soils in view
  of water purification for groundwater quality
- [`bln_wat_nretention_sw()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_wat_nretention_sw.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the N retention in soils in view
  of water purification for surface quality
- [`bln_wat_nrisk_gw()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_wat_nrisk_gw.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the N leaching risks in soils in
  view of water purification for groundwater quality
- [`bln_wat_nrunoff()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_wat_nrunoff.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the N leaching risk in soils in
  view of water purification for surface water quality
- [`bln_wat_pesticide()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/bln_wat_pesticide.md)
  : Function to calculate and evaluate the pesticide retention in soils
  in view of water purification for groundwater water quality
- [`cf_ind_importance()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/cf_ind_importance.md)
  : Helper function to weight and correct the risk and scores
- [`checkvar()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/checkvar.md) :
  Select the correct boundary values (min and max) for a given parameter
- [`ind_workability()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/ind_workability.md)
  : Calculate indicator for workability
- [`pF_curve()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/pF_curve.md) :
  Water retention curve
- [`pFpara_class()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/pFpara_class.md)
  : Parameter estimation based on class of Staringreeks (Tabel 3, Wosten
  2001)
- [`pFpara_ptf_Wosten1999()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/pFpara_ptf_Wosten1999.md)
  : Estimate water retention curve parameters based on Wosten 1999
- [`pFpara_ptf_Wosten2001()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/pFpara_ptf_Wosten2001.md)
  : Estimate water retention curve parameters based on Wosten 2001
- [`plot_bln_boxplot()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/plot_bln_boxplot.md)
  : Plot boxplots for BLN indicators and scores for a group of fields
- [`plot_bln_map()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/plot_bln_map.md)
  : Plot a BLN score or indicator on a map
- [`plot_bln_rothc_ts()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/plot_bln_rothc_ts.md)
  : Function to plot simple RothC simulation time series for a single
  field
- [`rothc_initialise()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/rothc_initialise.md)
  : Function for initializing the RothC model
- [`rothc_parallel()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/rothc_parallel.md)
  : function to run RothC parallel for a series of fields
- [`rothc_scenario()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/rothc_scenario.md)
  : Function to prepare inputs for various scenarios with RothC
- [`wf()`](https://nmi-agro.github.io/BLN/reference/wf.md) : Helper
  function to weight and correct the risk and scores
